name: Hoag Electronics Product Design and Development Engineering
old_description: Hoag Electronics is an electronics engineering product design consulting company that specializes in the design and development of new electronic products.
about:
Hoag Electronics Inc. was founded in 1986 by Tom E. Hoag in Bellevue, Washington, about ten miles east of Seattle. The Washington State corporation began as an electronics engineering consultancy focused on designing new products for original equipment manufacturers in the wireless radio, telecommunications, and industrial control sectors.

The firm provides a turnkey product development service that spans schematic capture, multi‑layer PCB layout (up to eight layers), microcontroller hardware and firmware development, analog/digital/mixed‑signal circuit design, and RF wireless link design for IrDA, GPS, and Bluetooth. It also operates a contract manufacturing line for prototype and production‑run assembly, handling both surface‑mount and through‑hole components, and delivers complete documentation packages including schematics, bills of materials, and manufacturing data.

Hoag serves OEMs worldwide, with a historical concentration in wireless radio, telecommunications, and industrial control equipment. Clients range from startups needing a first prototype to established companies requiring production‑scale assembly and test services.

The company emphasizes its 25‑plus years of design experience, status as a Motorola Professional Radio Application Partner and Authorized Licensed Application Developer, and a commitment to fast turnaround, quality, and responsive client support as its primary differentiators.
